title: Moinen's Assorted Dice
description: One dice pack for many games. Bundles several custom Dice So Nice! sets — carved stone (Stonetop), illuminated parchment (Mythic Bastionland) and weathered salvage-crate (Salvage Union) — and automatically prefers the set that matches your active game system. Every set stays available in the Dice So Nice library, so you can always pick another.
